decision: No new source-confirmed console/PC-to-phone project rows are staged in Round 13. Direct leads were checked against catalog targets; the only seemingly new high-signal PS1→Android group is a multi-repository build matrix whose game-specific child repos have not yet been individually verified, so it is held for follow-up rather than represented by its generic umbrella.

held_leads.evidence: Root README says the umbrella uses psxrecomp static recompilation for native Android apps; its games table reports Pixel 8 status and `.gitmodules` maps each title to a separate child repository. Root README and .gitmodules snapshots were captured.
held_leads.reason: The parent repository is a generic build orchestrator and documents that each game has its own child repo and README/license. The child repositories were not individually source-reviewed in time to confirm target revisions, per-game status, licenses, and source availability. Do not import any game rows based only on the umbrella README or as one umbrella game record.

held_leads.evidence: Maintainer repo README and release metadata say Android APK and iOS IPA v1.0.0 were published 2026-06-03, using user-supplied PC `REPO_Data`; repository root contains README only, GitHub Languages API is empty, no license is declared, and release contains only binary packages.
held_leads.reason: Hold: source/method and binary contents cannot be verified from the project’s public source; cannot accurately select Reimplementation vs another supported method. No source code or license is declared.

held_leads.evidence: Framework README describes a dynamic runtime porting framework for original Android ARMv7 games; BackStabRecomp child is described as an Android-to-Windows port.
held_leads.reason: Reverse direction (Android game to Windows), not a console/PC-to-phone port. Generic framework not a game-specific target row.

held_leads.evidence: Repository README calls it a bring-up branch and not a release build; Android 9+/ARM64/Vulkan and user ROM requirements are documented.
held_leads.reason: Held: no release build or license; no source-backed playable status; repository file listing includes an encrypted ROM-named file. No assets were downloaded.

catalog_dedupe: All enumerated direct candidates have an existing matching game/target or repo/target record, including Ottsel/Jak and Daxter iOS, AnnePad/Pokémon Stadium iOS, DriftDroid/Mario Kart Wii Android, Galaxy Android/Super Mario Galaxy, MW2 Android, Wind Waker HD Android variants, KartPad/Mario Kart Wii, NFS Most Wanted iOS, and HaloPad/Halo CE iOS. No second row was staged.
